title: Knowledge pool – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Knowledge pool
hero.lead: The Kaderblick knowledge pool collects training knowledge, tactics, nutrition, laws of the game, video analysis and other team topics. Posts can contain text, images, video, audio and external media links.

body:
Find posts

  1. Under Community, open the Knowledge pool tab.
  2. If several assignments are available, select the relevant team at the top.
  3. Select All or a category. The adjacent search narrows posts by their content.
  4. Select a tag on a post card to filter by that tag. The X on the filter chip clears it.

Pinned posts appear in a separate section before the remaining posts. A card shows a preview image or media type, category, title, tags, author, time, reactions and comments.

Open and use a post

  • Select a card to open its detailed view.
  • The content can contain formatted text, images and clickable links.
  • YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify and SoundCloud links appear in a suitable media view; other links remain external links.
  • Select the heart to react. The adjacent number shows existing reactions.
  • Write and submit a comment in the comments area. Existing comments appear below.
  • The X closes the detailed view and returns to the filtered overview.

Create a post

  1. Select the green plus.
  2. Select the team if several are offered.
  3. Enter the title in the club language marked as default. Use Add another language for further language versions.
  4. Select a category.
  5. Write the content in the editor. Its toolbar includes undo and redo, text format, bold, italic, lists, links, images, emoji and further functions.
  6. Add existing tags or create a new tag by name.
  7. Under Media links, enter a URL and select Add. Repeat for further media.
  8. If required, enable Notify team to send team members a push notification upon publication.
  9. Select Publish.

Edit a post you own or manage

Depending on permission, the detailed view shows Edit, Delete and Pin or Unpin. Edit opens the post form with the existing data. Delete requires confirmation. Pinned posts then appear at the beginning of the knowledge pool.

Differences by role

  • Players, parents, coaches and supporters with team access: read posts supplied for their team, react and comment.
  • Coaches and team members with editorial permission: additionally receive the plus and can create posts.
  • Author or managing person: sees the permitted edit, delete and pin actions.
  • Accounts with several teams: select the team context at the top; content and categories change with it.

Related areas

  • The team assignment comes from Clubs & teams.
  • Enabled team notices appear in Notifications.
  • Video and analysis posts supplement match-related areas but do not replace specific match videos.
